desc: Read input N, M and the edges.
Build an adjacency list for the graph.

Use BFS or DFS to find connected components and determine the bipartition (two-coloring) for each component. For each component, count the number of nodes in partition 0 ($cnt_0$) and partition 1 ($cnt_1$).
Calculate the total number of possible edges in the final complete bipartite graphs: sum($cnt_0 \times cnt_1$) for all components.
Subtract the initial number of edges M from this total to get the number of moves.
If the number of moves is odd, print "Aoki"; otherwise, print "Takahashi".
